market.question: Will any Category 5 hurricane make landfall in the US in before 2027?

assessment.reasoning: CSU forecasts a slightly below-average 2026 Atlantic season (13 named storms, 6 hurricanes, 2 majors); 32% chance of any major hurricane (Cat 3+) US landfall. Cat 5 specifically is much rarer — historical base rate of any Cat 5 US landfall is ~10-15% per year and tilted lower in below-average seasons.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Warm SSTs supporting rapid intensification could surprise to upside
